title: Unforgiving Skies
description: A heavy, atmosphere-driven weather survival modpack featuring dynamic seasons, severe localized storms, and harsh environmental temperature cycles.
body:
##### Unforgiving Skies overhauls the predictable weather patterns of vanilla Minecraft, turning the climate and atmosphere into an active element of your survival.

## What This Pack Adds
- Dynamic Weather Systems: Rain is replaced by moving pressure fronts. Light drizzles can naturally develop into heavy downpours, thick fog, or blinding blizzards depending on your current biome and elevation.

- Full Seasonal Cycles: The world constantly shifts through four distinct seasons. These cycles alter local temperatures, affect how fast your crops grow, and change animal behavior.

- Severe Storms and Tornadoes: High-pressure systems can trigger violent windstorms and localized tornadoes that are capable of ripping up unreinforced blocks, knocking down trees, and causing flash floods.

## Critical Information Before Downloading
- Shelter Mechanics: Standard wooden or open-air shelters will not survive this pack. Lightning routinely sparks massive wildfires, and wind storms will damage weak blocks. Upgrading to stone, reinforced materials, or building underground is highly recommended.

- Navigation Hazards: Severe weather events drastically reduce your render distance to near-zero visibility. Always carry a compass, maps, or directional markers when exploring, as it is incredibly easy to get permanently lost during a sudden blizzard or thick fog roll.
